fences.label: シーン: 沢へ到着した捜索者たちが立ち尽くす遠景。対岸に毛布で覆われた女性。
fences.text: A wide, distant view from far behind of four Japanese searchers who have just reached the edge of a small mountain stream in a leafless forest near Setana, southwestern Hokkaido, in mid-April early spring: bare grey deciduous trees, brown leaf litter, the first small green shoots, a few small patches of old snow only in shaded hollows, no fresh snow and no winter. Left to right: 1) a Japanese police officer in a dark navy uniform jacket and cap, 2) a Japanese firefighter in a navy rescue jacket with a white helmet, 3) a shorter Japanese firefighter in the same navy jacket, 4) a heavier-built Japanese police officer in a navy jacket. All four stand still in a loose row with their backs to the camera, heads lowered, arms hanging, only their backs and shoulders visible, no face visible. Beyond them on the far bank lies the woman they have found: a Japanese woman in a muted olive field jacket lying face-down and motionless among the stones, her body mostly covered by a plain grey blanket, one limp arm in the torn olive sleeve and one muddy boot showing at the blanket's edge, her face hidden, clearly dead and NOT sleeping, NOT resting. Nothing red and nothing stained. Framed from adult eye height about 20 metres behind the searchers, the camera angled slightly downward. Overcast, dim but NOT pure black, the searchers and the blanket stay clearly readable. Somber, devastating stillness, desaturated cool tones. Photorealistic, shot on RED camera. Documentary style. 16:9 aspect ratio. Generate 1 image.
